name: Veer Energy & Infrastructure Limited
about: Veer Energy & Infrastructure Limited develops, constructs, implements, and operates various projects in the renewable energy sector in India. The company offers off grid solar installations for power plants and rooftop solutions. It also creates infrastructure development facilities for the installation of wind turbine generator. In addition, the company offers comprehensive installation services, such as clean room equipment, panels, aluminum sliding windows, MS fabrication, and pipe installation services. Veer Energy & Infrastructure Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
